_comment: Third-party aggregate indices and leaderboards. A lab citing one of these is not reporting a benchmark result, it is citing somebody else's composite ranking, which is a different kind of claim and would distort the adoption trend this site measures. Matching is on the normalised key (lowercased, punctuation collapsed to spaces), as a substring.

patterns.reason: Artificial Analysis composite of three speech-to-speech evaluations. Its long spellings were already dropped by "artificial analysis"; the abbreviated AA form slipped past every pattern and was being tracked as a benchmark.
